# ALL logic lives in IstiN/dmtools-agentic-workflows/.github/workflows/
# factory-teammate.yml (guard, legs, verdict, sessions, memory). This file
# carries the repository event triggers + the call only.
#
# Gate: the loop starts when a human ASSIGNS an issue to `ai-teammate`.
# Secrets via `secrets: inherit`: SOURCE_GITHUB_TOKEN (present), plus
# ZAI_CODE_KEY / KIMI_REVIEW_KEY when the fa/zai runners are used.
#
# gh-676 (2026-10-03): while this file was unparseable (#669 residue —
# duplicate permission keys, fixed in #671), GitHub kept a stale push-event
# registration: every machine-sm state-publish push to `factory-data`
# spawned an instant-fail event=push run with zero jobs ("the phantom").
# This comment block is the standard cure — a no-op touch of the file: the
# default-branch blob change forces GitHub to re-index the registration
# from the real triggers below. There is NO push trigger by design; the
# trigger set (issues + workflow_dispatch only) and the duplicate-key
# ban are guarded by js/unit-tests/test_workflowLint.js.
name: AI Teammate

# gh-1065: the title carries the LEG for every path — the dispatch input
# leg directly, and for event-path runs the strongest arming label on the
# issue (rework > review > pr_approved → review > dev). legOfRunName
# (js/common/teammateEventDedup.js) parses the trailing token, so a
# COMPLETED owner stays title-precise: the strict completed-owner leg rule
# (a leg-less completed run never swallows a KNOWN new leg) can only work
# when real leg runs carry their leg in the title.
run-name: "teammate: ${{ github.event_name }} #${{ github.event.issue.number || github.event.inputs.issue }} ${{ github.event.inputs.leg || (contains(github.event.issue.labels.*.name, 'agent:rework') && 'rework') || (contains(github.event.issue.labels.*.name, 'agent:review') && 'review') || (contains(github.event.issue.labels.*.name, 'pr_approved') && 'review') || (contains(github.event.issue.labels.*.name, 'agent:dev') && 'dev') || (contains(github.event.issue.labels.*.name, 'agent:develop') && 'dev') || github.event.label.name }}"

on:
  issues:
    types: [assigned, labeled]
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      issue:
        description: 'Issue number (for dispatch runs)'
        type: string
      leg:
        description: 'Which leg to run'
        type: choice
        options: [dev, review, rework]
      reason:
        description: 'Why (audit trail)'
        type: string
      pr:
        description: 'PR number for PR-anchored runs (review leg on PRs born without an issue, #687)'
        required: false
        type: string
        default: ''

permissions:
  # The factory (factory-teammate.yml@e611e5f) requests this set and a
  # reusable workflow cannot RAISE rights above its caller — the stub must
  # grant the ceiling or every dispatch startup-fails (live dmtools-agents
  # 2026-10-03: 'requesting actions: write, contents: write, issues: write,
  # pull-requests: write, but is only allowed contents: read' — the issue-
  # driven dev lane never ran in this repo).
  actions: write
  contents: write
  issues: write
  pull-requests: write

concurrency:
  group: ai-teammate-${{ github.event.issue.number || github.event.inputs.issue }}
  cancel-in-progress: false

jobs:
  # gh-1065 (live 2026-10-18, issues #1040–#1043 / #1061): one human action
  # (assign, or assign-while-labels-change) emits MULTIPLE issues events and
  # each event started its own run — two per issue, three on #1061, the
  # owner hand-cancelling duplicates. The gh-1028 dedup guards the SM
  # dispatch path only; this job is the missing event-path gate. It probes
  # the repo's ai-teammate.yml runs (per-status gh api fan-out, smAgent
  # parity) and lets the `teammate` call fire only when no OLDER run for
  # the same issue + leg is in flight or freshly completed. Probe errors
  # FAIL OPEN (AC3): a broken check writes proceed=true so the only trigger
  # of a burst is never silently swallowed. The decision itself is the
  # unit-tested pure module js/common/teammateEventDedup.js (AC4) — this
  # step is transport only. The probe short-circuits BEFORE any API call
  # for workflow_dispatch (SM-side gh-1028 governs it), non-arming
  # gh-1029 zero-burn parity: the job-level `if:` above mirrors the
  # teammate gate, so non-arming lifecycle label writes execute ZERO jobs
  # (those runs conclude failure — the gh-676 phantom shape — and own no
  # dedup key). The in-probe preflight below remains as defense in depth
  # against gate drift. The probe short-circuits BEFORE any API call
  # for workflow_dispatch (SM-side gh-1028 governs it), non-arming
  # lifecycle labels and non-teammate assignees.
  dedup:
    name: Event-path dedup probe (gh-1065)
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    # gh-1065 rework (review thread — gh-1029 zero-burn parity): this gate
    # MIRRORS the teammate call gate below. `on:` fires on EVERY label
    # write repo-wide, and an unguarded dedup job would allocate a runner
    # (checkout + node boot) per lifecycle-label storm — the exact burn
    # gh-1029 eliminated. Rejected events now execute ZERO jobs: the run
    # concludes failure (the gh-676 phantom pattern) and — because only
    # conclusion 'success' owns the freshness window — can never suppress
    # a trigger for an issue whose leg never ran.
    if: >-
      github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch' ||
      (github.event_name == 'issues' &&
       github.event.action == 'assigned' &&
       contains(github.event.issue.assignees.*.login, 'ai-teammate')) ||
      (github.event_name == 'issues' &&
       github.event.action == 'labeled' &&
       (github.event.label.name == 'agent:dev' ||
        github.event.label.name == 'agent:develop' ||
        github.event.label.name == 'agent:review' ||
        github.event.label.name == 'agent:rework' ||
        github.event.label.name == 'pr_approved'))
    outputs:
      proceed: ${{ steps.probe.outputs.proceed }}
      audit: ${{ steps.probe.outputs.audit }}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - id: probe
        name: Decide whether this event duplicates an in-flight teammate run
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
          REPO: ${{ github.repository }}
          EVENT_NAME: ${{ github.event_name }}
          ACTION: ${{ github.event.action }}
          LABEL_NAME: ${{ github.event.label.name }}
          ISSUE_LABELS: ${{ toJson(github.event.issue.labels.*.name) }}
          ISSUE: ${{ github.event.issue.number || github.event.inputs.issue }}
          ASSIGNEES: ${{ toJson(github.event.issue.assignees.*.login) }}
          SELF_ID: ${{ github.run_id }}
          SELF_RUN_NUMBER: ${{ github.run_number }}
          WORKFLOW_FILE: ai-teammate.yml
          # GITHUB_OUTPUT is provided by the runner — do NOT set it here.
        run: |
          node <<'DEDUP_PROBE_EOF'
          const { execFileSync } = require('child_process');
          const fs = require('fs');
          const dedup = require('./js/common/teammateEventDedup.js');

          const env = process.env;
          // gh-1065 rework (review thread): label/login names may contain
          // spaces — the lists ride as JSON. Fallback: the legacy
          // space-joined shape still parses (defense in depth).
          const parseEventList = (raw) => {
            try {
              const v = JSON.parse(raw || '[]');
              if (Array.isArray(v)) return v.filter(Boolean);
            } catch (e) { /* legacy space-joined list — fall through */ }
            return (raw || '').split(' ').filter(Boolean);
          };
          const issueLabels = parseEventList(env.ISSUE_LABELS);
          const assignees = parseEventList(env.ASSIGNEES);

          const out = (proceed, audit) => {
            const line = String(audit).replace(/\s+/g, ' ').trim();
            fs.appendFileSync(env.GITHUB_OUTPUT || '/dev/null',
              `proceed=${proceed}\naudit=${line}\n`);

# AI Teammate — thin stub over the factory home (dmtools-agentic-workflows),
# SELF-HOSTED ENGINE: this repo IS the dmtools-agents engine, so factory_ref
# rides the triggering commit — the factory always executes the exact tree
# under development.
#
# ALL logic lives in IstiN/dmtools-agentic-workflows/.github/workflows/
# factory-teammate.yml (guard, legs, verdict, sessions, memory). This file
# carries the repository event triggers + the call only.
#
# Gate: the loop starts when a human ASSIGNS an issue to `ai-teammate`.
# Secrets via `secrets: inherit`: SOURCE_GITHUB_TOKEN (present), plus
# ZAI_CODE_KEY / KIMI_REVIEW_KEY when the fa/zai runners are used.
#
# gh-676 (2026-10-03): while this file was unparseable (#669 residue —
# duplicate permission keys, fixed in #671), GitHub kept a stale push-event
# registration: every machine-sm state-publish push to `factory-data`
# spawned an instant-fail event=push run with zero jobs ("the phantom").
# This comment block is the standard cure — a no-op touch of the file: the
# default-branch blob change forces GitHub to re-index the registration
# from the real triggers below. There is NO push trigger by design; the
# trigger set (issues + workflow_dispatch only) and the duplicate-key
# ban are guarded by js/unit-tests/test_workflowLint.js.
name: AI Teammate

# gh-1065: the title carries the LEG for every path — the dispatch input
# leg directly, and for event-path runs the strongest arming label on the
# issue (rework > review > pr_approved → review > dev). legOfRunName
# (js/common/teammateEventDedup.js) parses the trailing token, so a
# COMPLETED owner stays title-precise: the strict completed-owner leg rule
# (a leg-less completed run never swallows a KNOWN new leg) can only work
# when real leg runs carry their leg in the title.
run-name: "teammate: ${{ github.event_name }} #${{ github.event.issue.number || github.event.inputs.issue }} ${{ github.event.inputs.leg || (contains(github.event.issue.labels.*.name, 'agent:rework') && 'rework') || (contains(github.event.issue.labels.*.name, 'agent:review') && 'review') || (contains(github.event.issue.labels.*.name, 'pr_approved') && 'review') || (contains(github.event.issue.labels.*.name, 'agent:dev') && 'dev') || (contains(github.event.issue.labels.*.name, 'agent:develop') && 'dev') || github.event.label.name }}"

on:
  issues:
    types: [assigned, labeled]
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      issue:
        description: 'Issue number (for dispatch runs)'
        type: string
      leg:
        description: 'Which leg to run'
        type: choice
        options: [dev, review, rework]
      reason:
        description: 'Why (audit trail)'
        type: string
      pr:
        description: 'PR number for PR-anchored runs (review leg on PRs born without an issue, #687)'
        required: false
        type: string
        default: ''

permissions:
  # The factory (factory-teammate.yml@e611e5f) requests this set and a
  # reusable workflow cannot RAISE rights above its caller — the stub must
  # grant the ceiling or every dispatch startup-fails (live dmtools-agents
  # 2026-10-03: 'requesting actions: write, contents: write, issues: write,
  # pull-requests: write, but is only allowed contents: read' — the issue-
  # driven dev lane never ran in this repo).
  actions: write
  contents: write
  issues: write
  pull-requests: write

concurrency:
  group: ai-teammate-${{ github.event.issue.number || github.event.inputs.issue }}
  cancel-in-progress: false

jobs:
  # gh-1065 (live 2026-10-18, issues #1040–#1043 / #1061): one human action
  # (assign, or assign-while-labels-change) emits MULTIPLE issues events and
  # each event started its own run — two per issue, three on #1061, the
  # owner hand-cancelling duplicates. The gh-1028 dedup guards the SM
  # dispatch path only; this job is the missing event-path gate. It probes
  # the repo's ai-teammate.yml runs (per-status gh api fan-out, smAgent
  # parity) and lets the `teammate` call fire only when no OLDER run for
  # the same issue + leg is in flight or freshly completed. Probe errors
  # FAIL OPEN (AC3): a broken check writes proceed=true so the only trigger
  # of a burst is never silently swallowed. The decision itself is the
  # unit-tested pure module js/common/teammateEventDedup.js (AC4) — this
  # step is transport only. The probe short-circuits BEFORE any API call
  # for workflow_dispatch (SM-side gh-1028 governs it), non-arming
  # gh-1029 zero-burn parity: the job-level `if:` above mirrors the
  # teammate gate, so non-arming lifecycle label writes execute ZERO jobs
  # (those runs conclude failure — the gh-676 phantom shape — and own no
  # dedup key). The in-probe preflight below remains as defense in depth
  # against gate drift. The probe short-circuits BEFORE any API call
  # for workflow_dispatch (SM-side gh-1028 governs it), non-arming
  # lifecycle labels and non-teammate assignees.
  dedup:
    name: Event-path dedup probe (gh-1065)
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    # gh-1065 rework (review thread — gh-1029 zero-burn parity): this gate
    # MIRRORS the teammate call gate below. `on:` fires on EVERY label
    # write repo-wide, and an unguarded dedup job would allocate a runner
    # (checkout + node boot) per lifecycle-label storm — the exact burn
    # gh-1029 eliminated. Rejected events now execute ZERO jobs: the run
    # concludes failure (the gh-676 phantom pattern) and — because only
    # conclusion 'success' owns the freshness window — can never suppress
    # a trigger for an issue whose leg never ran.
    if: >-
      github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch' ||
      (github.event_name == 'issues' &&
       github.event.action == 'assigned' &&
       contains(github.event.issue.assignees.*.login, 'ai-teammate')) ||
      (github.event_name == 'issues' &&
       github.event.action == 'labeled' &&
       (github.event.label.name == 'agent:dev' ||
        github.event.label.name == 'agent:develop' ||
        github.event.label.name == 'agent:review' ||
        github.event.label.name == 'agent:rework' ||
        github.event.label.name == 'pr_approved'))
    outputs:
      proceed: ${{ steps.probe.outputs.proceed }}
      audit: ${{ steps.probe.outputs.audit }}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - id: probe
        name: Decide whether this event duplicates an in-flight teammate run
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
          REPO: ${{ github.repository }}
          EVENT_NAME: ${{ github.event_name }}
          ACTION: ${{ github.event.action }}
          LABEL_NAME: ${{ github.event.label.name }}
          ISSUE_LABELS: ${{ toJson(github.event.issue.labels.*.name) }}
          ISSUE: ${{ github.event.issue.number || github.event.inputs.issue }}
          ASSIGNEES: ${{ toJson(github.event.issue.assignees.*.login) }}
          SELF_ID: ${{ github.run_id }}
          SELF_RUN_NUMBER: ${{ github.run_number }}
          WORKFLOW_FILE: ai-teammate.yml
          # GITHUB_OUTPUT is provided by the runner — do NOT set it here.
        run: |
          node <<'DEDUP_PROBE_EOF'
          const { execFileSync } = require('child_process');
          const fs = require('fs');
          const dedup = require('./js/common/teammateEventDedup.js');

          const env = process.env;
          // gh-1065 rework (review thread): label/login names may contain
          // spaces — the lists ride as JSON. Fallback: the legacy
          // space-joined shape still parses (defense in depth).
          const parseEventList = (raw) => {
            try {
              const v = JSON.parse(raw || '[]');
              if (Array.isArray(v)) return v.filter(Boolean);
            } catch (e) { /* legacy space-joined list — fall through */ }
            return (raw || '').split(' ').filter(Boolean);
          };
          const issueLabels = parseEventList(env.ISSUE_LABELS);
          const assignees = parseEventList(env.ASSIGNEES);

          const out = (proceed, audit) => {
            const line = String(audit).replace(/\s+/g, ' ').trim();
            fs.appendFileSync(env.GITHUB_OUTPUT || '/dev/null',
              `proceed=${proceed}\naudit=${line}\n`);

# AI Teammate — thin stub over the factory home (dmtools-agentic-workflows),
# SELF-HOSTED ENGINE: this repo IS the dmtools-agents engine, so factory_ref
# rides the triggering commit — the factory always executes the exact tree
# under development.
#
# ALL logic lives in IstiN/dmtools-agentic-workflows/.github/workflows/
# factory-teammate.yml (guard, legs, verdict, sessions, memory). This file
# carries the repository event triggers + the call only.
#
# Gate: the loop starts when a human ASSIGNS an issue to `ai-teammate`.
# Secrets via `secrets: inherit`: SOURCE_GITHUB_TOKEN (present), plus
# ZAI_CODE_KEY / KIMI_REVIEW_KEY when the fa/zai runners are used.
#
# gh-676 (2026-10-03): while this file was unparseable (#669 residue —
# duplicate permission keys, fixed in #671), GitHub kept a stale push-event
# registration: every machine-sm state-publish push to `factory-data`
# spawned an instant-fail event=push run with zero jobs ("the phantom").
# This comment block is the standard cure — a no-op touch of the file: the
# default-branch blob change forces GitHub to re-index the registration
# from the real triggers below. There is NO push trigger by design; the
# trigger set (issues + workflow_dispatch only) and the duplicate-key
# ban are guarded by js/unit-tests/test_workflowLint.js.
name: AI Teammate

# gh-1065: the title carries the LEG for every path — the dispatch input
# leg directly, and for event-path runs the strongest arming label on the
# issue (rework > review > pr_approved → review > dev). legOfRunName
# (js/common/teammateEventDedup.js) parses the trailing token, so a
# COMPLETED owner stays title-precise: the strict completed-owner leg rule
# (a leg-less completed run never swallows a KNOWN new leg) can only work
# when real leg runs carry their leg in the title.
run-name: "teammate: ${{ github.event_name }} #${{ github.event.issue.number || github.event.inputs.issue }} ${{ github.event.inputs.leg || (contains(github.event.issue.labels.*.name, 'agent:rework') && 'rework') || (contains(github.event.issue.labels.*.name, 'agent:review') && 'review') || (contains(github.event.issue.labels.*.name, 'pr_approved') && 'review') || (contains(github.event.issue.labels.*.name, 'agent:dev') && 'dev') || (contains(github.event.issue.labels.*.name, 'agent:develop') && 'dev') || github.event.label.name }}"

on:
  issues:
    types: [assigned, labeled]
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      issue:
        description: 'Issue number (for dispatch runs)'
        type: string
      leg:
        description: 'Which leg to run'
        type: choice
        options: [dev, review, rework]
      reason:
        description: 'Why (audit trail)'
        type: string
      pr:
        description: 'PR number for PR-anchored runs (review leg on PRs born without an issue, #687)'
        required: false
        type: string
        default: ''

permissions:
  # The factory (factory-teammate.yml@e611e5f) requests this set and a
  # reusable workflow cannot RAISE rights above its caller — the stub must
  # grant the ceiling or every dispatch startup-fails (live dmtools-agents
  # 2026-10-03: 'requesting actions: write, contents: write, issues: write,
  # pull-requests: write, but is only allowed contents: read' — the issue-
  # driven dev lane never ran in this repo).
  actions: write
  contents: write
  issues: write
  pull-requests: write

concurrency:
  group: ai-teammate-${{ github.event.issue.number || github.event.inputs.issue }}
  cancel-in-progress: false

jobs:
  # gh-1065 (live 2026-10-18, issues #1040–#1043 / #1061): one human action
  # (assign, or assign-while-labels-change) emits MULTIPLE issues events and
  # each event started its own run — two per issue, three on #1061, the
  # owner hand-cancelling duplicates. The gh-1028 dedup guards the SM
  # dispatch path only; this job is the missing event-path gate. It probes
  # the repo's ai-teammate.yml runs (per-status gh api fan-out, smAgent
  # parity) and lets the `teammate` call fire only when no OLDER run for
  # the same issue + leg is in flight or freshly completed. Probe errors
  # FAIL OPEN (AC3): a broken check writes proceed=true so the only trigger
  # of a burst is never silently swallowed. The decision itself is the
  # unit-tested pure module js/common/teammateEventDedup.js (AC4) — this
  # step is transport only. The probe short-circuits BEFORE any API call
  # for workflow_dispatch (SM-side gh-1028 governs it), non-arming
  # gh-1029 zero-burn parity: the job-level `if:` above mirrors the
  # teammate gate, so non-arming lifecycle label writes execute ZERO jobs
  # (those runs conclude failure — the gh-676 phantom shape — and own no
  # dedup key). The in-probe preflight below remains as defense in depth
  # against gate drift. The probe short-circuits BEFORE any API call
  # for workflow_dispatch (SM-side gh-1028 governs it), non-arming
  # lifecycle labels and non-teammate assignees.
  dedup:
    name: Event-path dedup probe (gh-1065)
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    # gh-1065 rework (review thread — gh-1029 zero-burn parity): this gate
    # MIRRORS the teammate call gate below. `on:` fires on EVERY label
    # write repo-wide, and an unguarded dedup job would allocate a runner
    # (checkout + node boot) per lifecycle-label storm — the exact burn
    # gh-1029 eliminated. Rejected events now execute ZERO jobs: the run
    # concludes failure (the gh-676 phantom pattern) and — because only
    # conclusion 'success' owns the freshness window — can never suppress
    # a trigger for an issue whose leg never ran.
    if: >-
      github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch' ||
      (github.event_name == 'issues' &&
       github.event.action == 'assigned' &&
       contains(github.event.issue.assignees.*.login, 'ai-teammate')) ||
      (github.event_name == 'issues' &&
       github.event.action == 'labeled' &&
       (github.event.label.name == 'agent:dev' ||
        github.event.label.name == 'agent:develop' ||
        github.event.label.name == 'agent:review' ||
        github.event.label.name == 'agent:rework' ||
        github.event.label.name == 'pr_approved'))
    outputs:
      proceed: ${{ steps.probe.outputs.proceed }}
      audit: ${{ steps.probe.outputs.audit }}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - id: probe
        name: Decide whether this event duplicates an in-flight teammate run
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
          REPO: ${{ github.repository }}
          EVENT_NAME: ${{ github.event_name }}
          ACTION: ${{ github.event.action }}
          LABEL_NAME: ${{ github.event.label.name }}
          ISSUE_LABELS: ${{ toJson(github.event.issue.labels.*.name) }}
          ISSUE: ${{ github.event.issue.number || github.event.inputs.issue }}
          ASSIGNEES: ${{ toJson(github.event.issue.assignees.*.login) }}
          SELF_ID: ${{ github.run_id }}
          SELF_RUN_NUMBER: ${{ github.run_number }}
          WORKFLOW_FILE: ai-teammate.yml
          # GITHUB_OUTPUT is provided by the runner — do NOT set it here.
        run: |
          node <<'DEDUP_PROBE_EOF'
          const { execFileSync } = require('child_process');
          const fs = require('fs');
          const dedup = require('./js/common/teammateEventDedup.js');

          const env = process.env;
          // gh-1065 rework (review thread): label/login names may contain
          // spaces — the lists ride as JSON. Fallback: the legacy
          // space-joined shape still parses (defense in depth).
          const parseEventList = (raw) => {
            try {
              const v = JSON.parse(raw || '[]');
              if (Array.isArray(v)) return v.filter(Boolean);
            } catch (e) { /* legacy space-joined list — fall through */ }
            return (raw || '').split(' ').filter(Boolean);
          };
          const issueLabels = parseEventList(env.ISSUE_LABELS);
          const assignees = parseEventList(env.ASSIGNEES);

          const out = (proceed, audit) => {
            const line = String(audit).replace(/\s+/g, ' ').trim();
            fs.appendFileSync(env.GITHUB_OUTPUT || '/dev/null',
              `proceed=${proceed}\naudit=${line}\n`);

# Rework — addressing all 6 open review threads

Rework pass on head `8d10f916` → `2541aca1`. Both BLOCKING threads, both IMPORTANT threads and both SUGGESTION threads are fixed in code; every open thread has a targeted reply in `outputs/review_replies/`.

## Issues/Notes

- **🚨 BLOCKING — `crap` quality gate (CI red):** `decideEventDedup` (CC 27), `issueOfRunName` (11), `legOfRunName` (9), `isOlderRun` (9) decomposed. Max CC in the module is now **7**; verified locally with the workflow's exact pinned tool (`IstiN/crap4js@83ee620`, same install path as `quality.yml`): every function in the changed files measures **CRAP ≤ 7.8** (threshold 8), including the coverage-mapped run (`crap4js . --coverage coverage-final.json --threshold 8`).
- **🚨 BLOCKING — runs that never executed the leg owned the freshness window:** fixed two ways, combined (the reviewer's "either or both"):
  1. The `dedup` job now carries an `if:` mirroring the arming gate (thread 3 fix), so non-arming lifecycle-label writes execute **zero jobs** — those runs conclude `failure` (the gh-676 phantom pattern) and own no dedup key.
  2. New **strict completed-owner leg rule** (`completedLegsCompatible`): the leg wildcard is scoped to *in-flight* owners only. A completed owner with an unknown leg can no longer suppress a KNOWN-leg event, so even a stray `success` run (e.g. a dropped duplicate whose sibling ran the leg) cannot swallow a genuinely new leg request.
- **Transport bug found by the mocked-`gh` smoke:** the probe never passed `nowMs`, so the module degraded to in-flight-only and the 10-minute freshness window was **inert in production** (the AC2 path — burst duplicates released by the concurrency group after the first run completed — would have proceeded as duplicates). The probe now passes `nowMs: Date.now()`; a wiring test pins it.
- **IMPORTANT — runner burn on every label write:** the `dedup` job's new `if:` gate restores gh-1029 zero-burn; behavior for admitted events is unchanged.
- **IMPORTANT — wildcard swallowed sequential human actions:** fixed by the strict completed-owner rule plus a **run-name change**: event-path run titles now carry the strongest arming label (`rework > review > pr_approved→review > dev`), so real leg runs stay title-precise and AC2/AC4 burst suppression still works after completion (regression-tested).
- **SUGGESTION — space-joined env lists:** `ISSUE_LABELS`/`ASSIGNEES` now ride as `toJson(...)` and the probe parses them with a JSON parser (legacy space-joined fallback kept).
- **SUGGESTION — template mirror follow-up:** filed as **[#1073](https://github.com/IstiN/dmtools-agents/issues/1073)** and noted in the module header.

## Approach

TDD per finding: RED tests reproducing each thread's scenario first (5 failed as expected), then the fix, then GREEN, then the full suite + coverage + pinned crap4js as the CI-parity gate.

- `js/common/teammateEventDedup.js` — decomposed into single-responsibility helpers (`anchoredNumberOf` shared by the two anchor regex families, `emojiLegOf`/`stubTailLegOf`, `isSuppressorRun`/`findSuppressor` for the six-condition loop body, `scanVerdict` + verdict builders, `olderByCreatedAt`); added `completedLegsCompatible` + `ownerLegCompatible` for the scoped wildcard; docstrings corrected (the "never swallowed" claim now states the actual scoped semantics); template-mirror follow-up noted in the header.
- `.github/workflows/ai-teammate.yml` — `dedup` job `if:` gate (zero-burn + phantom-failure owners); `toJson` env lists + `parseEventList`; `nowMs: Date.now()`; run-name carries the label-derived leg.
- `js/unit-tests/test_teammateEventDedup.js` — 10 new tests (strict completed legs, sequential-action regression, in-flight wildcard preserved, burst-after-completion with carried legs, `isLegWorkflowRun` full branch coverage, dedup-job gate wiring, run-name leg wiring, JSON env wiring, transport clock wiring).
- `js/unit-tests/test_workflowLint.js` — `extractJobIf` retargeted at the **call** gate (marker: `needs.dedup.outputs.proceed`), split into `foldedIfBlocks` + `extractJobIf` (CC 9 → 4+6) so the gh-1029 contract keeps guarding the `teammate` job while the dedup gate is asserted in the dedup suite.

## Files Modified

- `js/common/teammateEventDedup.js`
- `.github/workflows/ai-teammate.yml`
- `js/unit-tests/test_teammateEventDedup.js`
- `js/unit-tests/test_workflowLint.js`

## Test Coverage

- Unit suite (`test_teammateEventDedup.js`): **40/40 PASS** (was 30).
- Workflow lint contract (`test_workflowLint.js`): **30/30 PASS** (gh-1029 gate now explicitly bound to the call gate).
- Both suites together: 70/70 PASS.
- **Full suite** (`run_all.json`, node harness mirror): **4558 passed, 0 failed**.
- **CI-parity quality gate**: instrumented-tree coverage run + pinned `crap4js . --coverage … --threshold 8` — every function in the changed files ≤ **7.8** CRAP (max CC 7); no new function exceeds the threshold; the only modified baselined function (`extractJobIf`) shrank 9.0 → 4.0.
- **Transport smoke** (embedded probe executed against a mocked `gh`, 13 checks): duplicate drop, earliest-proceeds tie-break, 5/5-status degraded fail-open, dispatch + non-arming preflights with zero API burn, fresh-success same-leg drop, fresh-success different-leg proceeds, space-y JSON lists — **13/13 PASS**.
- Follow-up ticket for the template mirror: **#1073**.

# AI Teammate — thin stub over the factory home (dmtools-agentic-workflows),
# SELF-HOSTED ENGINE: this repo IS the dmtools-agents engine, so factory_ref
# rides the triggering commit — the factory always executes the exact tree
# under development.
#
# ALL logic lives in IstiN/dmtools-agentic-workflows/.github/workflows/
# factory-teammate.yml (guard, legs, verdict, sessions, memory). This file
# carries the repository event triggers + the call only.
#
# Gate: the loop starts when a human ASSIGNS an issue to `ai-teammate`.
# Secrets via `secrets: inherit`: SOURCE_GITHUB_TOKEN (present), plus
# ZAI_CODE_KEY / KIMI_REVIEW_KEY when the fa/zai runners are used.
#
# gh-676 (2026-10-03): while this file was unparseable (#669 residue —
# duplicate permission keys, fixed in #671), GitHub kept a stale push-event
# registration: every machine-sm state-publish push to `factory-data`
# spawned an instant-fail event=push run with zero jobs ("the phantom").
# This comment block is the standard cure — a no-op touch of the file: the
# default-branch blob change forces GitHub to re-index the registration
# from the real triggers below. There is NO push trigger by design; the
# trigger set (issues + workflow_dispatch only) and the duplicate-key
# ban are guarded by js/unit-tests/test_workflowLint.js.
name: AI Teammate

# gh-1065: the title carries the LEG for every path — the dispatch input
# leg directly, and for event-path runs the strongest arming label on the
# issue (rework > review > pr_approved → review > dev). legOfRunName
# (js/common/teammateEventDedup.js) parses the trailing token, so a
# COMPLETED owner stays title-precise: the strict completed-owner leg rule
# (a leg-less completed run never swallows a KNOWN new leg) can only work
# when real leg runs carry their leg in the title.
run-name: "teammate: ${{ github.event_name }} #${{ github.event.issue.number || github.event.inputs.issue }} ${{ github.event.inputs.leg || (contains(github.event.issue.labels.*.name, 'agent:rework') && 'rework') || (contains(github.event.issue.labels.*.name, 'agent:review') && 'review') || (contains(github.event.issue.labels.*.name, 'pr_approved') && 'review') || (contains(github.event.issue.labels.*.name, 'agent:dev') && 'dev') || (contains(github.event.issue.labels.*.name, 'agent:develop') && 'dev') || github.event.label.name }}"

on:
  issues:
    types: [assigned, labeled]
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      issue:
        description: 'Issue number (for dispatch runs)'
        type: string
      leg:
        description: 'Which leg to run'
        type: choice
        options: [dev, review, rework]
      reason:
        description: 'Why (audit trail)'
        type: string
      pr:
        description: 'PR number for PR-anchored runs (review leg on PRs born without an issue, #687)'
        required: false
        type: string
        default: ''

permissions:
  # The factory (factory-teammate.yml@e611e5f) requests this set and a
  # reusable workflow cannot RAISE rights above its caller — the stub must
  # grant the ceiling or every dispatch startup-fails (live dmtools-agents
  # 2026-10-03: 'requesting actions: write, contents: write, issues: write,
  # pull-requests: write, but is only allowed contents: read' — the issue-
  # driven dev lane never ran in this repo).
  actions: write
  contents: write
  issues: write
  pull-requests: write

concurrency:
  group: ai-teammate-${{ github.event.issue.number || github.event.inputs.issue }}
  cancel-in-progress: false

jobs:
  # gh-1065 (live 2026-10-18, issues #1040–#1043 / #1061): one human action
  # (assign, or assign-while-labels-change) emits MULTIPLE issues events and
  # each event started its own run — two per issue, three on #1061, the
  # owner hand-cancelling duplicates. The gh-1028 dedup guards the SM
  # dispatch path only; this job is the missing event-path gate. It probes
  # the repo's ai-teammate.yml runs (per-status gh api fan-out, smAgent
  # parity) and lets the `teammate` call fire only when no OLDER run for
  # the same issue + leg is in flight or freshly completed. Probe errors
  # FAIL OPEN (AC3): a broken check writes proceed=true so the only trigger
  # of a burst is never silently swallowed. The decision itself is the
  # unit-tested pure module js/common/teammateEventDedup.js (AC4) — this
  # step is transport only. The probe short-circuits BEFORE any API call
  # for workflow_dispatch (SM-side gh-1028 governs it), non-arming
  # gh-1029 zero-burn parity: the job-level `if:` above mirrors the
  # teammate gate, so non-arming lifecycle label writes execute ZERO jobs
  # (those runs conclude failure — the gh-676 phantom shape — and own no
  # dedup key). The in-probe preflight below remains as defense in depth
  # against gate drift. The probe short-circuits BEFORE any API call
  # for workflow_dispatch (SM-side gh-1028 governs it), non-arming
  # lifecycle labels and non-teammate assignees.
  dedup:
    name: Event-path dedup probe (gh-1065)
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    # gh-1065 rework (review thread — gh-1029 zero-burn parity): this gate
    # MIRRORS the teammate call gate below. `on:` fires on EVERY label
    # write repo-wide, and an unguarded dedup job would allocate a runner
    # (checkout + node boot) per lifecycle-label storm — the exact burn
    # gh-1029 eliminated. Rejected events now execute ZERO jobs: the run
    # concludes failure (the gh-676 phantom pattern) and — because only
    # conclusion 'success' owns the freshness window — can never suppress
    # a trigger for an issue whose leg never ran.
    if: >-
      github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch' ||
      (github.event_name == 'issues' &&
       github.event.action == 'assigned' &&
       contains(github.event.issue.assignees.*.login, 'ai-teammate')) ||
      (github.event_name == 'issues' &&
       github.event.action == 'labeled' &&
       (github.event.label.name == 'agent:dev' ||
        github.event.label.name == 'agent:develop' ||
        github.event.label.name == 'agent:review' ||
        github.event.label.name == 'agent:rework' ||
        github.event.label.name == 'pr_approved'))
    outputs:
      proceed: ${{ steps.probe.outputs.proceed }}
      audit: ${{ steps.probe.outputs.audit }}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - id: probe
        name: Decide whether this event duplicates an in-flight teammate run
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
          REPO: ${{ github.repository }}
          EVENT_NAME: ${{ github.event_name }}
          ACTION: ${{ github.event.action }}
          LABEL_NAME: ${{ github.event.label.name }}
          ISSUE_LABELS: ${{ toJson(github.event.issue.labels.*.name) }}
          ISSUE: ${{ github.event.issue.number || github.event.inputs.issue }}
          ASSIGNEES: ${{ toJson(github.event.issue.assignees.*.login) }}
          SELF_ID: ${{ github.run_id }}
          SELF_RUN_NUMBER: ${{ github.run_number }}
          WORKFLOW_FILE: ai-teammate.yml
          # GITHUB_OUTPUT is provided by the runner — do NOT set it here.
        run: |
          node <<'DEDUP_PROBE_EOF'
          const { execFileSync } = require('child_process');
          const fs = require('fs');
          const dedup = require('./js/common/teammateEventDedup.js');

          const env = process.env;
          // gh-1065 rework (review thread): label/login names may contain
          // spaces — the lists ride as JSON. Fallback: the legacy
          // space-joined shape still parses (defense in depth).
          const parseEventList = (raw) => {
            try {
              const v = JSON.parse(raw || '[]');
              if (Array.isArray(v)) return v.filter(Boolean);
            } catch (e) { /* legacy space-joined list — fall through */ }
            return (raw || '').split(' ').filter(Boolean);
          };
          const issueLabels = parseEventList(env.ISSUE_LABELS);
          const assignees = parseEventList(env.ASSIGNEES);

          const out = (proceed, audit) => {
            const line = String(audit).replace(/\s+/g, ' ').trim();
            fs.appendFileSync(env.GITHUB_OUTPUT || '/dev/null',
              `proceed=${proceed}\naudit=${line}\n`);

run-name: "teammate: ${{ github.event_name }} #${{ github.event.issue.number || github.event.inputs.issue }} ${{ github.event.inputs.leg || (contains(github.event.issue.labels.*.name, 'agent:rework') && 'rework') || (contains(github.event.issue.labels.*.name, 'agent:review') && 'review') || (contains(github.event.issue.labels.*.name, 'pr_approved') && 'review') || (contains(github.event.issue.labels.*.name, 'agent:dev') && 'dev') || (contains(github.event.issue.labels.*.name, 'agent:develop') && 'dev') || github.event.label.name }}"

on:
  issues:
    types: [assigned, labeled]
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      issue:
        description: 'Issue number (for dispatch runs)'
        type: string
      leg:
        description: 'Which leg to run'
        type: choice
        options: [dev, review, rework]
      reason:
        description: 'Why (audit trail)'
        type: string
      pr:
        description: 'PR number for PR-anchored runs (review leg on PRs born without an issue, #687)'
        required: false
        type: string
        default: ''

permissions:
  # The factory (factory-teammate.yml@e611e5f) requests this set and a
  # reusable workflow cannot RAISE rights above its caller — the stub must
  # grant the ceiling or every dispatch startup-fails (live dmtools-agents
  # 2026-10-03: 'requesting actions: write, contents: write, issues: write,
  # pull-requests: write, but is only allowed contents: read' — the issue-
  # driven dev lane never ran in this repo).
  actions: write
  contents: write
  issues: write
  pull-requests: write

concurrency:
  group: ai-teammate-${{ github.event.issue.number || github.event.inputs.issue }}
  cancel-in-progress: false

jobs:
  # gh-1065 (live 2026-10-18, issues #1040–#1043 / #1061): one human action
  # (assign, or assign-while-labels-change) emits MULTIPLE issues events and
  # each event started its own run — two per issue, three on #1061, the
  # owner hand-cancelling duplicates. The gh-1028 dedup guards the SM
  # dispatch path only; this job is the missing event-path gate. It probes
  # the repo's ai-teammate.yml runs (per-status gh api fan-out, smAgent
  # parity) and lets the `teammate` call fire only when no OLDER run for
  # the same issue + leg is in flight or freshly completed. Probe errors
  # FAIL OPEN (AC3): a broken check writes proceed=true so the only trigger
  # of a burst is never silently swallowed. The decision itself is the
  # unit-tested pure module js/common/teammateEventDedup.js (AC4) — this
  # step is transport only. The probe short-circuits BEFORE any API call
  # for workflow_dispatch (SM-side gh-1028 governs it), non-arming
  # gh-1029 zero-burn parity: the job-level `if:` above mirrors the
  # teammate gate, so non-arming lifecycle label writes execute ZERO jobs
  # (those runs conclude failure — the gh-676 phantom shape — and own no
  # dedup key). The in-probe preflight below remains as defense in depth
  # against gate drift. The probe short-circuits BEFORE any API call
  # for workflow_dispatch (SM-side gh-1028 governs it), non-arming
  # lifecycle labels and non-teammate assignees.
  dedup:
    name: Event-path dedup probe (gh-1065)
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    # gh-1065 rework (review thread — gh-1029 zero-burn parity): this gate
    # MIRRORS the teammate call gate below. `on:` fires on EVERY label
    # write repo-wide, and an unguarded dedup job would allocate a runner
    # (checkout + node boot) per lifecycle-label storm — the exact burn
    # gh-1029 eliminated. Rejected events now execute ZERO jobs: the run
    # concludes failure (the gh-676 phantom pattern) and — because only
    # conclusion 'success' owns the freshness window — can never suppress
    # a trigger for an issue whose leg never ran.
    if: >-
      github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch' ||
      (github.event_name == 'issues' &&
       github.event.action == 'assigned' &&
       contains(github.event.issue.assignees.*.login, 'ai-teammate')) ||
      (github.event_name == 'issues' &&
       github.event.action == 'labeled' &&
       (github.event.label.name == 'agent:dev' ||
        github.event.label.name == 'agent:develop' ||
        github.event.label.name == 'agent:review' ||
        github.event.label.name == 'agent:rework' ||
        github.event.label.name == 'pr_approved'))
    outputs:
      proceed: ${{ steps.probe.outputs.proceed }}
      audit: ${{ steps.probe.outputs.audit }}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - id: probe
        name: Decide whether this event duplicates an in-flight teammate run
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
          REPO: ${{ github.repository }}
          EVENT_NAME: ${{ github.event_name }}
          ACTION: ${{ github.event.action }}
          LABEL_NAME: ${{ github.event.label.name }}
          ISSUE_LABELS: ${{ toJson(github.event.issue.labels.*.name) }}
          ISSUE: ${{ github.event.issue.number || github.event.inputs.issue }}
          ASSIGNEES: ${{ toJson(github.event.issue.assignees.*.login) }}
          SELF_ID: ${{ github.run_id }}
          SELF_RUN_NUMBER: ${{ github.run_number }}
          WORKFLOW_FILE: ai-teammate.yml
          # GITHUB_OUTPUT is provided by the runner — do NOT set it here.
        run: |
          node <<'DEDUP_PROBE_EOF'
          const { execFileSync } = require('child_process');
          const fs = require('fs');
          const dedup = require('./js/common/teammateEventDedup.js');

          const env = process.env;
          // gh-1065 rework (review thread): label/login names may contain
          // spaces — the lists ride as JSON. Fallback: the legacy
          // space-joined shape still parses (defense in depth).
          const parseEventList = (raw) => {
            try {
              const v = JSON.parse(raw || '[]');
              if (Array.isArray(v)) return v.filter(Boolean);
            } catch (e) { /* legacy space-joined list — fall through */ }
            return (raw || '').split(' ').filter(Boolean);
          };
          const issueLabels = parseEventList(env.ISSUE_LABELS);
          const assignees = parseEventList(env.ASSIGNEES);

          const out = (proceed, audit) => {
            const line = String(audit).replace(/\s+/g, ' ').trim();
            fs.appendFileSync(env.GITHUB_OUTPUT || '/dev/null',
              `proceed=${proceed}\naudit=${line}\n`);

{"content":"# Rework — addressing all 6 open review threads

Rework pass on head `8d10f916` → `2541aca1`. Both BLOCKING threads, both IMPORTANT threads and both SUGGESTION threads are fixed in code; every open thread has a targeted reply in `outputs/review_replies/`.

## Issues/Notes

- **🚨 BLOCKING — `crap` quality gate (CI red):** `decideEventDedup` (CC 27), `issueOfRunName` (11), `legOfRunName` (9), `isOlderRun` (9) decomposed. Max CC in the module is now **7**; verified locally with the workflow's exact pinned tool (`IstiN/crap4js@83ee620`, same install path as `quality.yml`): every function in the changed files measures **CRAP ≤ 7.8** (threshold 8), including the coverage-mapped run (`crap4js . --coverage coverage-final.json --threshold 8`).
- **🚨 BLOCKING — runs that never executed the leg owned the freshness window:** fixed two ways, combined (the reviewer's "either or both"):
  1. The `dedup` job now carries an `if:` mirroring the arming gate (thread 3 fix), so non-arming lifecycle-label writes execute **zero jobs** — those runs conclude `failure` (the gh-676 phantom pattern) and own no dedup key.
  2. New **strict completed-owner leg rule** (`completedLegsCompatible`): the leg wildcard is scoped to *in-flight* owners only. A completed owner with an unknown leg can no longer suppress a KNOWN-leg event, so even a stray `success` run (e.g. a dropped duplicate whose sibling ran the leg) cannot swallow a genuinely new leg request.
- **Transport bug found by the mocked-`gh` smoke:** the probe never passed `nowMs`, so the module degraded to in-flight-only and the 10-minute freshness window was **inert in production** (the AC2 path — burst duplicates released by the concurrency group after the first run completed — would have proceeded as duplicates). The probe now passes `nowMs: Date.now()`; a wiring test pins it.
- **IMPORTANT — runner burn on every label write:** the `dedup` job's new `if:` gate restores gh-1029 zero-burn; behavior for admitted events is unchanged.
- **IMPORTANT — wildcard swallowed sequential human actions:** fixed by the strict completed-owner rule plus a **run-name change**: event-path run titles now carry the strongest arming label (`rework > review > pr_approved→review > dev`), so real leg runs stay title-precise and AC2/AC4 burst suppression still works after completion (regression-tested).
- **SUGGESTION — space-joined env lists:** `ISSUE_LABELS`/`ASSIGNEES` now ride as `toJson(...)` and the probe parses them with a JSON parser (legacy space-joined fallback kept).
- **SUGGESTION — template mirror follow-up:** filed as **[#1073](https://github.com/IstiN/dmtools-agents/issues/1073)** and noted in the module header.

## Approach

TDD per finding: RED tests reproducing each thread's scenario first (5 failed as expected), then the fix, then GREEN, then the full suite + coverage + pinned crap4js as the CI-parity gate.

- `js/common/teammateEventDedup.js` — decomposed into single-responsibility helpers (`anchoredNumberOf` shared by the two anchor regex families, `emojiLegOf`/`stubTailLegOf`, `isSuppressorRun`/`findSuppressor` for the six-condition loop body, `scanVerdict` + verdict builders, `olderByCreatedAt`); added `completedLegsCompatible` + `ownerLegCompatible` for the scoped wildcard; docstrings corrected (the "never swallowed" claim now states the actual scoped semantics); template-mirror follow-up noted in the header.
- `.github/workflows/ai-teammate.yml` — `dedup` job `if:` gate (zero-burn + phantom-failure owners); `toJson` env lists + `parseEventList`; `nowMs: Date.now()`; run-name carries the label-derived leg.
- `js/unit-tests/test_teammateEventDedup.js` — 10 new tests (strict completed legs, sequential-action regression, in-flight wildcard preserved, burst-after-completion with carried legs, `isLegWorkflowRun` full branch coverage, dedup-job gate wiring, run-name leg wiring, JSON env wiring, transport clock wiring).
- `js/unit-tests/test_workflowLint.js` — `extractJobIf` retargeted at the **call** gate (marker: `needs.dedup.outputs.proceed`), split into `foldedIfBlocks` + `extractJobIf` (CC 9 → 4+6) so the gh-1029 contract keeps guarding the `teammate` job while the dedup gate is asserted in the dedup suite.

# Thread 2 — BLOCKING: runs that never executed the leg own the freshness window

Fixed with the reviewer's option 2 + a module-level backstop (option 1's jobs-API probe is no longer needed):

1. **The `dedup` job now carries an `if:` mirroring the arming gate** (see the thread-3 fix). A non-arming lifecycle-label write therefore executes **zero jobs**, the run concludes `failure` (the gh-676 phantom pattern documented in this file), and — since only `conclusion: success` owns the freshness window — it can never suppress a trigger for an issue whose leg never ran. The always-succeeds-`dedup`-job hole is closed at the source.
2. **Strict completed-owner leg rule** (`completedLegsCompatible` in the module): even for the remaining `success` runs that never executed the leg themselves (a dropped duplicate — whose burst sibling did run the leg), the leg wildcard no longer applies to *completed* owners. A leg-less completed owner can suppress only another leg-less (bare-assign) event inside the window; it can never swallow a KNOWN-leg trigger. The unit suite previously couldn't catch this because synthetic `conclusion: 'success'` runs were assumed to mean "the leg ran" — there are now regression tests for both directions (leg-less completed owner vs known-leg event → proceeds; leg-carrying completed owner vs same-leg burst duplicate → drops).

**Transport-level regression caught while verifying** (exactly the gap this thread predicted): the probe never passed `nowMs`, so the module silently degraded to in-flight-only and the 10-minute freshness window was **inert in production** — the AC2 scenario (burst duplicates released by the concurrency group after the first run completed) would have proceeded as duplicates. The probe now passes `nowMs: Date.now()`, and a wiring test pins the transport contract.

Verified end-to-end with the embedded probe executed against a mocked `gh` (13 checks, all pass), including: fresh-success same-leg duplicate drop, fresh-success different-leg proceeds, and 5/5-status degraded fail-open.

# AI Teammate — thin stub over the factory home (dmtools-agentic-workflows),
# SELF-HOSTED ENGINE: this repo IS the dmtools-agents engine, so factory_ref
# rides the triggering commit — the factory always executes the exact tree
# under development.
#
# ALL logic lives in IstiN/dmtools-agentic-workflows/.github/workflows/
# factory-teammate.yml (guard, legs, verdict, sessions, memory). This file
# carries the repository event triggers + the call only.
#
# Gate: the loop starts when a human ASSIGNS an issue to `ai-teammate`.
# Secrets via `secrets: inherit`: SOURCE_GITHUB_TOKEN (present), plus
# ZAI_CODE_KEY / KIMI_REVIEW_KEY when the fa/zai runners are used.
#
# gh-676 (2026-10-03): while this file was unparseable (#669 residue —
# duplicate permission keys, fixed in #671), GitHub kept a stale push-event
# registration: every machine-sm state-publish push to `factory-data`
# spawned an instant-fail event=push run with zero jobs ("the phantom").
# This comment block is the standard cure — a no-op touch of the file: the
# default-branch blob change forces GitHub to re-index the registration
# from the real triggers below. There is NO push trigger by design; the
# trigger set (issues + workflow_dispatch only) and the duplicate-key
# ban are guarded by js/unit-tests/test_workflowLint.js.
name: AI Teammate

# gh-1065: the title carries the LEG for every path — the dispatch input
# leg directly, and for event-path runs the strongest arming label on the
# issue (rework > review > pr_approved → review > dev). legOfRunName
# (js/common/teammateEventDedup.js) parses the trailing token, so a
# COMPLETED owner stays title-precise: the strict completed-owner leg rule
# (a leg-less completed run never swallows a KNOWN new leg) can only work
# when real leg runs carry their leg in the title.
run-name: "teammate: ${{ github.event_name }} #${{ github.event.issue.number || github.event.inputs.issue }} ${{ github.event.inputs.leg || (contains(github.event.issue.labels.*.name, 'agent:rework') && 'rework') || (contains(github.event.issue.labels.*.name, 'agent:review') && 'review') || (contains(github.event.issue.labels.*.name, 'pr_approved') && 'review') || (contains(github.event.issue.labels.*.name, 'agent:dev') && 'dev') || (contains(github.event.issue.labels.*.name, 'agent:develop') && 'dev') || github.event.label.name }}"

on:
  issues:
    types: [assigned, labeled]
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      issue:
        description: 'Issue number (for dispatch runs)'
        type: string
      leg:
        description: 'Which leg to run'
        type: choice
        options: [dev, review, rework]
      reason:
        description: 'Why (audit trail)'
        type: string
      pr:
        description: 'PR number for PR-anchored runs (review leg on PRs born without an issue, #687)'
        required: false
        type: string
        default: ''

permissions:
  # The factory (factory-teammate.yml@e611e5f) requests this set and a
  # reusable workflow cannot RAISE rights above its caller — the stub must
  # grant the ceiling or every dispatch startup-fails (live dmtools-agents
  # 2026-10-03: 'requesting actions: write, contents: write, issues: write,
  # pull-requests: write, but is only allowed contents: read' — the issue-
  # driven dev lane never ran in this repo).
  actions: write
  contents: write
  issues: write
  pull-requests: write

concurrency:
  group: ai-teammate-${{ github.event.issue.number || github.event.inputs.issue }}
  cancel-in-progress: false

jobs:
  # gh-1065 (live 2026-10-18, issues #1040–#1043 / #1061): one human action
  # (assign, or assign-while-labels-change) emits MULTIPLE issues events and
  # each event started its own run — two per issue, three on #1061, the
  # owner hand-cancelling duplicates. The gh-1028 dedup guards the SM
  # dispatch path only; this job is the missing event-path gate. It probes
  # the repo's ai-teammate.yml runs (per-status gh api fan-out, smAgent
  # parity) and lets the `teammate` call fire only when no OLDER run for
  # the same issue + leg is in flight or freshly completed. Probe errors
  # FAIL OPEN (AC3): a broken check writes proceed=true so the only trigger
  # of a burst is never silently swallowed. The decision itself is the
  # unit-tested pure module js/common/teammateEventDedup.js (AC4) — this
  # step is transport only. The probe short-circuits BEFORE any API call
  # for workflow_dispatch (SM-side gh-1028 governs it), non-arming
  # gh-1029 zero-burn parity: the job-level `if:` above mirrors the
  # teammate gate, so non-arming lifecycle label writes execute ZERO jobs
  # (those runs conclude failure — the gh-676 phantom shape — and own no
  # dedup key). The in-probe preflight below remains as defense in depth
  # against gate drift. The probe short-circuits BEFORE any API call
  # for workflow_dispatch (SM-side gh-1028 governs it), non-arming
  # lifecycle labels and non-teammate assignees.
  dedup:
    name: Event-path dedup probe (gh-1065)
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    # gh-1065 rework (review thread — gh-1029 zero-burn parity): this gate
    # MIRRORS the teammate call gate below. `on:` fires on EVERY label
    # write repo-wide, and an unguarded dedup job would allocate a runner
    # (checkout + node boot) per lifecycle-label storm — the exact burn
    # gh-1029 eliminated. Rejected events now execute ZERO jobs: the run
    # concludes failure (the gh-676 phantom pattern) and — because only
    # conclusion 'success' owns the freshness window — can never suppress
    # a trigger for an issue whose leg never ran.
    if: >-
      github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch' ||
      (github.event_name == 'issues' &&
       github.event.action == 'assigned' &&
       contains(github.event.issue.assignees.*.login, 'ai-teammate')) ||
      (github.event_name == 'issues' &&
       github.event.action == 'labeled' &&
       (github.event.label.name == 'agent:dev' ||
        github.event.label.name == 'agent:develop' ||
        github.event.label.name == 'agent:review' ||
        github.event.label.name == 'agent:rework' ||
        github.event.label.name == 'pr_approved'))
    outputs:
      proceed: ${{ steps.probe.outputs.proceed }}
      audit: ${{ steps.probe.outputs.audit }}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - id: probe
        name: Decide whether this event duplicates an in-flight teammate run
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
          REPO: ${{ github.repository }}
          EVENT_NAME: ${{ github.event_name }}
          ACTION: ${{ github.event.action }}
          LABEL_NAME: ${{ github.event.label.name }}
          ISSUE_LABELS: ${{ toJson(github.event.issue.labels.*.name) }}
          ISSUE: ${{ github.event.issue.number || github.event.inputs.issue }}
          ASSIGNEES: ${{ toJson(github.event.issue.assignees.*.login) }}
          SELF_ID: ${{ github.run_id }}
          SELF_RUN_NUMBER: ${{ github.run_number }}
          WORKFLOW_FILE: ai-teammate.yml
          # GITHUB_OUTPUT is provided by the runner — do NOT set it here.
        run: |
          node <<'DEDUP_PROBE_EOF'
          const { execFileSync } = require('child_process');
          const fs = require('fs');
          const dedup = require('./js/common/teammateEventDedup.js');

          const env = process.env;
          // gh-1065 rework (review thread): label/login names may contain
          // spaces — the lists ride as JSON. Fallback: the legacy
          // space-joined shape still parses (defense in depth).
          const parseEventList = (raw) => {
            try {
              const v = JSON.parse(raw || '[]');
              if (Array.isArray(v)) return v.filter(Boolean);
            } catch (e) { /* legacy space-joined list — fall through */ }
            return (raw || '').split(' ').filter(Boolean);
          };
          const issueLabels = parseEventList(env.ISSUE_LABELS);
          const assignees = parseEventList(env.ASSIGNEES);

          const out = (proceed, audit) => {
            const line = String(audit).replace(/\s+/g, ' ').trim();
            fs.appendFileSync(env.GITHUB_OUTPUT || '/dev/null',
              `proceed=${proceed}\naudit=${line}\n`);

{"content":"# Rework — addressing all 6 open review threads

Rework pass on head `8d10f916` → `2541aca1`. Both BLOCKING threads, both IMPORTANT threads and both SUGGESTION threads are fixed in code; every open thread has a targeted reply in `outputs/review_replies/`.

## Issues/Notes

- **🚨 BLOCKING — `crap` quality gate (CI red):** `decideEventDedup` (CC 27), `issueOfRunName` (11), `legOfRunName` (9), `isOlderRun` (9) decomposed. Max CC in the module is now **7**; verified locally with the workflow's exact pinned tool (`IstiN/crap4js@83ee620`, same install path as `quality.yml`): every function in the changed files measures **CRAP ≤ 7.8** (threshold 8), including the coverage-mapped run (`crap4js . --coverage coverage-final.json --threshold 8`).
- **🚨 BLOCKING — runs that never executed the leg owned the freshness window:** fixed two ways, combined (the reviewer's "either or both"):
  1. The `dedup` job now carries an `if:` mirroring the arming gate (thread 3 fix), so non-arming lifecycle-label writes execute **zero jobs** — those runs conclude `failure` (the gh-676 phantom pattern) and own no dedup key.
  2. New **strict completed-owner leg rule** (`completedLegsCompatible`): the leg wildcard is scoped to *in-flight* owners only. A completed owner with an unknown leg can no longer suppress a KNOWN-leg event, so even a stray `success` run (e.g. a dropped duplicate whose sibling ran the leg) cannot swallow a genuinely new leg request.
- **Transport bug found by the mocked-`gh` smoke:** the probe never passed `nowMs`, so the module degraded to in-flight-only and the 10-minute freshness window was **inert in production** (the AC2 path — burst duplicates released by the concurrency group after the first run completed — would have proceeded as duplicates). The probe now passes `nowMs: Date.now()`; a wiring test pins it.
- **IMPORTANT — runner burn on every label write:** the `dedup` job's new `if:` gate restores gh-1029 zero-burn; behavior for admitted events is unchanged.
- **IMPORTANT — wildcard swallowed sequential human actions:** fixed by the strict completed-owner rule plus a **run-name change**: event-path run titles now carry the strongest arming label (`rework > review > pr_approved→review > dev`), so real leg runs stay title-precise and AC2/AC4 burst suppression still works after completion (regression-tested).
- **SUGGESTION — space-joined env lists:** `ISSUE_LABELS`/`ASSIGNEES` now ride as `toJson(...)` and the probe parses them with a JSON parser (legacy space-joined fallback kept).
- **SUGGESTION — template mirror follow-up:** filed as **[#1073](https://github.com/IstiN/dmtools-agents/issues/1073)** and noted in the module header.

- `js/unit-tests/test_teammateEventDedup.js` — 10 new tests (strict completed legs, sequential-action regression, in-flight wildcard preserved, burst-after-completion with carried legs, `isLegWorkflowRun` full branch coverage, dedup-job gate wiring, run-name leg wiring, JSON env wiring, transport clock wiring).

{"content":"# Thread 2 — BLOCKING: runs that never executed the leg own the freshness window

Fixed with the reviewer's option 2 + a module-level backstop (option 1's jobs-API probe is no longer needed):

1. **The `dedup` job now carries an `if:` mirroring the arming gate** (see the thread-3 fix). A non-arming lifecycle-label write therefore executes **zero jobs**, the run concludes `failure` (the gh-676 phantom pattern documented in this file), and — since only `conclusion: success` owns the freshness window — it can never suppress a trigger for an issue whose leg never ran. The always-succeeds-`dedup`-job hole is closed at the source.
2. **Strict completed-owner leg rule** (`completedLegsCompatible` in the module): even for the remaining `success` runs that never executed the leg themselves (a dropped duplicate — whose burst sibling did run the leg), the leg wildcard no longer applies to *completed* owners. A leg-less completed owner can suppress only another leg-less (bare-assign) event inside the window; it can never swallow a KNOWN-leg trigger. The unit suite previously couldn't catch this because synthetic `conclusion: 'success'` runs were assumed to mean "the leg ran" — there are now regression tests for both directions (leg-less completed owner vs known-leg event → proceeds; leg-carrying completed owner vs same-leg burst duplicate → drops).

**Transport-level regression caught while verifying** (exactly the gap this thread predicted): the probe never passed `nowMs`, so the module silently degraded to in-flight-only and the 10-minute freshness window was **inert in production** — the AC2 scenario (burst duplicates released by the concurrency group after the first run completed) would have proceeded as duplicates. The probe now passes `nowMs: Date.now()`, and a wiring test pins the transport contract.

Verified end-to-end with the embedded probe executed against a mocked `gh` (13 checks, all pass), including: fresh-success same-leg duplicate drop, fresh-success different-leg proceeds, and 5/5-status degraded fail-open.

# AI Teammate — thin stub over the factory home (dmtools-agentic-workflows),
# SELF-HOSTED ENGINE: this repo IS the dmtools-agents engine, so factory_ref
# rides the triggering commit — the factory always executes the exact tree
# under development.
#
# ALL logic lives in IstiN/dmtools-agentic-workflows/.github/workflows/
# factory-teammate.yml (guard, legs, verdict, sessions, memory). This file
# carries the repository event triggers + the call only.
#
# Gate: the loop starts when a human ASSIGNS an issue to `ai-teammate`.
# Secrets via `secrets: inherit`: SOURCE_GITHUB_TOKEN (present), plus
# ZAI_CODE_KEY / KIMI_REVIEW_KEY when the fa/zai runners are used.
#
# gh-676 (2026-10-03): while this file was unparseable (#669 residue —
# duplicate permission keys, fixed in #671), GitHub kept a stale push-event
# registration: every machine-sm state-publish push to `factory-data`
# spawned an instant-fail event=push run with zero jobs ("the phantom").
# This comment block is the standard cure — a no-op touch of the file: the
# default-branch blob change forces GitHub to re-index the registration
# from the real triggers below. There is NO push trigger by design; the
# trigger set (issues + workflow_dispatch only) and the duplicate-key
# ban are guarded by js/unit-tests/test_workflowLint.js.
name: AI Teammate

# gh-1065: the title carries the LEG for every path — the dispatch input
# leg directly, and for event-path runs the strongest arming label on the
# issue (rework > review > pr_approved → review > dev). legOfRunName
# (js/common/teammateEventDedup.js) parses the trailing token, so a
# COMPLETED owner stays title-precise: the strict completed-owner leg rule
# (a leg-less completed run never swallows a KNOWN new leg) can only work
# when real leg runs carry their leg in the title.
run-name: "teammate: ${{ github.event_name }} #${{ github.event.issue.number || github.event.inputs.issue }} ${{ github.event.inputs.leg || (contains(github.event.issue.labels.*.name, 'agent:rework') && 'rework') || (contains(github.event.issue.labels.*.name, 'agent:review') && 'review') || (contains(github.event.issue.labels.*.name, 'pr_approved') && 'review') || (contains(github.event.issue.labels.*.name, 'agent:dev') && 'dev') || (contains(github.event.issue.labels.*.name, 'agent:develop') && 'dev') || github.event.label.name }}"

on:
  issues:
    types: [assigned, labeled]
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      issue:
        description: 'Issue number (for dispatch runs)'
        type: string
      leg:
        description: 'Which leg to run'
        type: choice
        options: [dev, review, rework]
      reason:
        description: 'Why (audit trail)'
        type: string
      pr:
        description: 'PR number for PR-anchored runs (review leg on PRs born without an issue, #687)'
        required: false
        type: string
        default: ''

permissions:
  # The factory (factory-teammate.yml@e611e5f) requests this set and a
  # reusable workflow cannot RAISE rights above its caller — the stub must
  # grant the ceiling or every dispatch startup-fails (live dmtools-agents
  # 2026-10-03: 'requesting actions: write, contents: write, issues: write,
  # pull-requests: write, but is only allowed contents: read' — the issue-
  # driven dev lane never ran in this repo).
  actions: write
  contents: write
  issues: write
  pull-requests: write

concurrency:
  group: ai-teammate-${{ github.event.issue.number || github.event.inputs.issue }}
  cancel-in-progress: false

jobs:
  # gh-1065 (live 2026-10-18, issues #1040–#1043 / #1061): one human action
  # (assign, or assign-while-labels-change) emits MULTIPLE issues events and
  # each event started its own run — two per issue, three on #1061, the
  # owner hand-cancelling duplicates. The gh-1028 dedup guards the SM
  # dispatch path only; this job is the missing event-path gate. It probes
  # the repo's ai-teammate.yml runs (per-status gh api fan-out, smAgent
  # parity) and lets the `teammate` call fire only when no OLDER run for
  # the same issue + leg is in flight or freshly completed. Probe errors
  # FAIL OPEN (AC3): a broken check writes proceed=true so the only trigger
  # of a burst is never silently swallowed. The decision itself is the
  # unit-tested pure module js/common/teammateEventDedup.js (AC4) — this
  # step is transport only. The probe short-circuits BEFORE any API call
  # for workflow_dispatch (SM-side gh-1028 governs it), non-arming
  # gh-1029 zero-burn parity: the job-level `if:` above mirrors the
  # teammate gate, so non-arming lifecycle label writes execute ZERO jobs
  # (those runs conclude failure — the gh-676 phantom shape — and own no
  # dedup key). The in-probe preflight below remains as defense in depth
  # against gate drift. The probe short-circuits BEFORE any API call
  # for workflow_dispatch (SM-side gh-1028 governs it), non-arming
  # lifecycle labels and non-teammate assignees.
  dedup:
    name: Event-path dedup probe (gh-1065)
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    # gh-1065 rework (review thread — gh-1029 zero-burn parity): this gate
    # MIRRORS the teammate call gate below. `on:` fires on EVERY label
    # write repo-wide, and an unguarded dedup job would allocate a runner
    # (checkout + node boot) per lifecycle-label storm — the exact burn
    # gh-1029 eliminated. Rejected events now execute ZERO jobs: the run
    # concludes failure (the gh-676 phantom pattern) and — because only
    # conclusion 'success' owns the freshness window — can never suppress
    # a trigger for an issue whose leg never ran.
    if: >-
      github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch' ||
      (github.event_name == 'issues' &&
       github.event.action == 'assigned' &&
       contains(github.event.issue.assignees.*.login, 'ai-teammate')) ||
      (github.event_name == 'issues' &&
       github.event.action == 'labeled' &&
       (github.event.label.name == 'agent:dev' ||
        github.event.label.name == 'agent:develop' ||
        github.event.label.name == 'agent:review' ||
        github.event.label.name == 'agent:rework' ||
        github.event.label.name == 'pr_approved'))
    outputs:
      proceed: ${{ steps.probe.outputs.proceed }}
      audit: ${{ steps.probe.outputs.audit }}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - id: probe
        name: Decide whether this event duplicates an in-flight teammate run
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
          REPO: ${{ github.repository }}
          EVENT_NAME: ${{ github.event_name }}
          ACTION: ${{ github.event.action }}
          LABEL_NAME: ${{ github.event.label.name }}
          ISSUE_LABELS: ${{ toJson(github.event.issue.labels.*.name) }}
          ISSUE: ${{ github.event.issue.number || github.event.inputs.issue }}
          ASSIGNEES: ${{ toJson(github.event.issue.assignees.*.login) }}
          SELF_ID: ${{ github.run_id }}
          SELF_RUN_NUMBER: ${{ github.run_number }}
          WORKFLOW_FILE: ai-teammate.yml
          # GITHUB_OUTPUT is provided by the runner — do NOT set it here.
        run: |
          node <<'DEDUP_PROBE_EOF'
          const { execFileSync } = require('child_process');
          const fs = require('fs');
          const dedup = require('./js/common/teammateEventDedup.js');

          const env = process.env;
          // gh-1065 rework (review thread): label/login names may contain
          // spaces — the lists ride as JSON. Fallback: the legacy
          // space-joined shape still parses (defense in depth).
          const parseEventList = (raw) => {
            try {
              const v = JSON.parse(raw || '[]');
              if (Array.isArray(v)) return v.filter(Boolean);
            } catch (e) { /* legacy space-joined list — fall through */ }
            return (raw || '').split(' ').filter(Boolean);
          };
          const issueLabels = parseEventList(env.ISSUE_LABELS);
          const assignees = parseEventList(env.ASSIGNEES);

          const out = (proceed, audit) => {
            const line = String(audit).replace(/\s+/g, ' ').trim();
            fs.appendFileSync(env.GITHUB_OUTPUT || '/dev/null',
              `proceed=${proceed}\naudit=${line}\n`);

# Thread 4 — IMPORTANT: wildcard leg + fresh-success window swallowed sequential human actions

Confirmed not intended — fixed by **scoping the wildcard to in-flight owners**, exactly as suggested, plus one supporting change that keeps the burst case sound:

- New `completedLegsCompatible`: a **completed** owner suppresses only when both legs are unknown (a second bare assign inside the window stays burst noise) or both known and equal (the concurrency-released burst duplicate). A completed owner with an unknown leg no longer suppresses a KNOWN new leg — the assign-at-T → deliberate `agent:review`-at-T+6min sequence now proceeds.
- **In-flight** owners keep the wildcard (`legsCompatible`, unchanged) — a same-second burst's event-path titles genuinely cannot be told apart.
- Supporting change: the stub **run-name now carries the label-derived leg** (`rework > review > pr_approved→review > dev`, same priority as the module's `assigned` derivation).
